blocks.content: We learned some pretty similar concepts in this lesson, and it's easy to confuse them with one another. So, you can review this summarized version to avoid possible confusion:

items: Walk: Vertices may repeat. Edges may repeat.
Trail: Vertices may repeat. Edges cannot be repeated.
Circuit: A closed trail. Starts and ends with the same vertex.
Path: Vertices cannot repeat. Edges cannot be repeated.
Cycle: A closed path. Starts and ends with the same vertex.

blocks.content: Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
